statement: Dolphin native ControllerInterface uses status, LED ACK, report 0x37, EEPROM acceleration calibration and optional IR/speaker setup, then normal A400FA identity, A600FE/1 readability poll, A600F0=55 and A600FE mode activation. It accepts mapped A400FA/6 with byte five 05, reads A40020/32 gyro calibration for MP-only, and when a Nunchuk or Classic is downstream additionally requests A400F6/4 split child ID then A40040/16 child calibration. F7 and 0x50 challenge are not required by this specific host path.

applicability.revision: TR/Gen 2 pinned consumer paths; no retail or firmware revision measured
